title: A free Stardock Fences alternative: PecoFence vs Fences | PecoFence
description: PecoFence is a free, open-source alternative to Stardock Fences for Windows 11 and 10. Fences, tabs, sorting rules, folder fences and Peek, in about 2 to 5 MB of memory at rest.
h1: A free alternative to Stardock Fences: PecoFence
lead: If you want the desktop organizing that Stardock Fences does without paying for it, use PecoFence. It is free and open source, runs on Windows 11 and 10, and groups desktop icons into fences with tabs, sorting rules, folder fences and Peek. At rest it uses about 2 to 5 MB of memory.
table_title: PecoFence and Stardock Fences side by side
rows: One shortcut searches the files in every fence
Open and Save dialogs jump to the folder open in File Explorer
A set of fences for each virtual desktop
extras: Smart fences: save a search as a fence, such as the downloads of the last 7 days or every file over 1 GB, and matching files show up by themselves.
Let your AI agent set it up: the built-in command line tool lets Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read and change your layout, appearance and sorting rules.
Search finds Chinese names by pinyin, and tool fences have a plugin store.
faq: Is there a free alternative to Stardock Fences?
Yes, PecoFence. It is free and open source under the Apache 2.0 license, and it has the fences, tabs, sorting rules, folder fences and Peek that Fences has.
Yes. It runs on Windows 10 1809 or later and on Windows 11 22H2 or later. The Microsoft Store edition needs Windows 10 2004 or later.
No. Sorting rules only change which fence shows a file, and the file stays where it is on disk. Moves you start yourself work exactly as in File Explorer.
How much memory does PecoFence use?
About 2 to 5 MB at rest in Task Manager. It is a native Rust application, and the Settings window loads WebView2 only while it is open.
Install it from the Microsoft Store, or run winget install DayuanJiang.PecoFence. A portable ZIP and an installer are on the GitHub releases page.
What happens to my desktop when I exit PecoFence?
Your desktop icons come back when you exit, and the Windows desktop works as usual.
source: The price and features of Fences come from Stardock's website, its Fences 7 release announcement of 18 November 2026 and its published changelog.
band_text: Fences, tabs, sorting rules, folder fences and Peek: PecoFence has them all, and it is free and open source.
